description: This Perl script analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v' to produce statistics about Git pack objects, including sizes, delta chains, tree structures, and optional filename annotations. It supports various modes for detailed tree representation and data dumping.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical measures (min, max, total, mean, median, std_dev) for a list of numeric data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Formats and prints statistical summaries for a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses the object graph to collect size and path size data, optionally printing tree structure.
